claim: Turnout in Algeria's municipal (APC) elections on Saturday 28 November 2026, as announced on election night, is at or below the 35.97% announced on election night in 2021.

runs.scenario: If voting takes place on 28 November and ANIE first announces turnout of 35.97% at 00:15 on 29 November in Algiers, one reader could resolve YES because the criterion explicitly contemplates an early-29-November announcement. Another could resolve NO because the event window ends at 23:59 on 28 November and could be read as applying to the announcement as well as to voting.
runs.yes_requires: The elections must be held on 28 November 2026, and the first official national turnout figure announced after polls close for the municipal people's assemblies (APC) must be 35.97% or lower. If only a combined APC/APW or average figure is announced, that figure counts. Hourly figures and later revisions do not count.
runs.decided_by: The announcement by ANIE's president, or, if ANIE does not announce a figure, the Interior Ministry's official national turnout announcement.

runs.scenario: The close-of-polls announcement occurs in the early hours of Sunday, 29 November 2026 (Africa/Algiers) with a turnout of 35.97% or lower. One reader resolves YES because the Criterion explicitly states that the announcement normally occurs 'late on 28 Nov or early 29 Nov', while another reader resolves NO because the Event window ends at 2026-11-28T23:59:00+01:00 and states 'The claim is NO if the event does not happen in this window.'
runs.yes_requires: The first national close-of-polls turnout figure for Algeria's 28 November 2026 municipal (APC) elections—announced by ANIE's president or, failing that, by the Interior Ministry—must be 35.97% or lower.
runs.decided_by: The president of Algeria's Independent National Authority for Elections (ANIE), or the Interior Ministry if ANIE does not announce the figure.

runs.scenario: The first official national figure is announced early on 29 Nov 2026 (Africa/Algiers), after the window's 23:59 cutoff on 28 Nov, at a level clearly above or below 35.97%. One reader follows the criterion, which treats an early-29 Nov close-of-polls announcement as decisive; the other follows the event window, which makes the claim NO if the event does not occur by 23:59 on 28 Nov.
runs.yes_requires: APC elections are held on 28 Nov 2026 and the first official national APC turnout announced at the close of polls is 35.97% or lower, from ANIE's president or, if ANIE announces none, from the Interior Ministry as the official national figure. Hourly interim figures and later revisions do not count; a combined APC/APW or average figure counts only if no separate APC figure is given.
runs.decided_by: ANIE's president, or if ANIE does not announce the figure, the Interior Ministry as the official national source.
